notes: One field for the registration-to-X=0 distance. It was set in three places - Registration sensor X, Register to X=0, and the PLC's own copy - none synced, and with two of them set they worked against each other: the beam fed forward to the cutting window correctly, then MEBP drove it back by the duplicated offset. There is now a single Registration sensor -> X=0 field, and saving zeroes the PLC's copy so the distance cannot be applied twice. The positioning equation is on the telemetry screen - beam position and target conveyor position alongside the reg-to-start value - so a material position error can be read off rather than guessed at. The Dimetix and slip readouts refresh at 10 Hz instead of twice a second, at about a fifth more traffic rather than double.
